_comment: Example .mcp.json with both MCPs (personal + client). Copy it into your project.
Both are remote HTTP with OAuth (Keycloak): on the 1st use Claude does a 401 → discovers the AS
via /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource → PKCE login in the browser → bearer + refresh.
Mirroring is the agent's task: ask it to read my-org/* from 'memory-my-org' and write to the
my-org workspace of 'memory-personal' (write via /admin, role mcp:write).
